name: Noor Block-Print Top
description: A relaxed square-neck top hand block-printed by artisans in Bagru with a tiny buti motif. Puff sleeves with elasticated cuffs and a cropped length that sits perfectly over high-waist jeans or a flowy skirt.

name: Saanjh Mul Cotton Top
description: Feather-light mul cotton in a soft sand tone, finished with pintucks along the yoke and hand-done tassel ties. Your everyday top for college, cafés and long summer afternoons.

name: Meher Chikankari Kurti
description: Hand-embroidered chikankari on breathable georgette, cut in a straight silhouette with side slits and three-quarter sleeves. Comes with a detachable cotton slip.

name: Rangrez Bandhani Kurti
description: Traditional bandhani tie-dye reimagined in a modern A-line kurti. Mandarin collar, concealed placket and a gentle flare that moves beautifully.

name: Kesar A-Line Kurti
description: A sunny saffron A-line kurti in textured cotton slub with contrast thread detailing at the neckline. Pair with white palazzos or your favourite denim.

name: Zari Brocade Corset
description: Banarasi brocade woven with antique-gold zari, structured with flexible boning and a back lace-up for an adjustable fit. Wear it with a saree, a skirt or wide-leg trousers.

name: Ajrakh Lace-Up Corset
description: Natural-dye ajrakh print on a sweetheart-neck corset with front lace-up detail. Softly padded cups and a cotton lining keep it comfortable all day.

name: Mitti Tiered Maxi Dress
description: Three generous tiers of handloom cotton in a warm clay shade, with a smocked bodice and adjustable tie straps. Fully lined, with pockets.

name: Chandni Wrap Dress
description: A true wrap dress in breathable linen blend with hand-done kantha running stitch on the hem. Ties at the waist for a flattering fit on every body.

name: Sahil Linen Midi Dress
description: A clean-lined midi in pure linen with coconut-shell buttons, a V-neck and side pockets. Effortless from brunch to a beach evening.

name: Paithani-Edge Co-ord Set
description: A handcrafted set: a boxy cropped shirt and straight pants in black cotton silk, edged with a woven Paithani-style border. Our love letter to Yeola weaves.

name: Ruhani Kurta Co-ord Set
description: A short kurta and tapered pant set in olive chanderi with subtle self-stripes and hand-finished pin-tucks. Elevated, easy and office-ready.

name: Dhoop Kaftan Co-ord
description: A breezy kaftan top with dolman sleeves and matching drawstring pants in fluid viscose crepe, printed with a hand-drawn sun motif.

name: Rani Mirror-Work Lehenga Set
fabric: Silk blend with hand mirror work
description: A festive lehenga set with a cropped blouse, flared skirt and sheer dupatta, finished with hand-stitched mirror work. Light enough to dance in all night.

name: Gulnaar Gota Anarkali
description: A floor-grazing anarkali in dusty rose chanderi with delicate gota patti borders and a matching organza dupatta. Made for haldi, mehendi and Diwali.

name: Tara Sequin Corset Top
description: A strappy corset top scattered with hand-sewn tonal sequins that catch the light. Pair with a lehenga skirt for festive nights or with denim for a party.
